prompt: Create an original 90 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 106 BPM; G major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A serene and contemplative piece featuring traditional Chinese instruments. A guzheng plays a delicate melody, supported by a melancholic erhu and a gentle flute, creating a peaceful and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而沉思的曲子，以中国传统乐器为主。古筝演奏着精致的旋律，二胡的忧郁和长笛的柔和相得益彰，营造出平和而富有内省的氛围。
